responsibility: Holds the generated machine-description patterns and peepholes for Nios II R2 CDX multiword stack and memory transfer instructions such as ldwm, stwm, push.n, and pop.n. It matches parallel save/restore or grouped load/store RTL sequences, emits the compact encodings when register sets and stack offsets fit the hardware forms, and invokes helper logic such as gen_ldstwm_peep to collapse ordinary instruction runs into these compressed transfers during late RTL optimization.
